evidence_scope: Core scalar X/Y key transactions and mixed combined/axis edits. This evidence does not qualify Studio scalar-axis gestures or complete the broader Composer goal.
tested_behavior: Move, copy and delete scalar keys through captured shared aliases while preserving physical move IDs and clearing copied IDs and drivers.
Resolve scalar ownership independently of the combined animator, including local alias arrays and retired scalar generations.
Apply combined, X and Y edits in one transaction with signed fractional clocks; axis-only edits preserve the combined key vector, tracks, bindings and local separated flags.
Deduplicate agreeing alias pins; refuse conflicting destinations, stale payloads, invalid axes, non-scalar values, cold arrays and insufficient payload budgets without publishing a result.
Admit weighted name-lookup work before scalar resolution and charge axis fanout before cloning; round-trip accepted fixtures through native persistence and restore captured bindings.
